tasks.title: Portfolio Rebalancing System
tasks.description: Implement automated portfolio rebalancing recommendations based on risk tolerance and market conditions
tasks.details: Create a system that analyzes current portfolio allocation and suggests rebalancing actions to maintain optimal risk-return profile. Include risk tolerance assessment, market condition analysis, and automated recommendation engine.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various portfolio configurations, different risk tolerances, and market scenarios. Verify recommendations are actionable and financially sound.

tasks.title: Tax Loss Harvesting Engine
tasks.description: Develop smart selling strategies to optimize tax efficiency for portfolio positions
tasks.details: Build an algorithm that identifies opportunities for tax loss harvesting by analyzing position performance, holding periods, and tax implications. Include wash sale rule compliance and optimization strategies.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various portfolio scenarios, different tax jurisdictions, and edge cases like wash sales. Verify compliance with tax regulations.

tasks.title: Dynamic Risk Management Rules
tasks.description: Implement dynamic position sizing based on volatility and market conditions
tasks.details: Create a risk management system that automatically adjusts position sizes based on asset volatility, market conditions, and portfolio risk metrics. Include stop-loss recommendations and position sizing algorithms.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with different market conditions, volatility levels, and portfolio sizes. Verify risk calculations are accurate and recommendations are appropriate.

tasks.title: Community Insights Platform
tasks.description: Build social features for sharing portfolio strategies and performance with the community
tasks.details: Create a social platform where users can share portfolio strategies, performance metrics, and insights. Include privacy controls, performance verification, and community engagement features.
tasks.testStrategy: Test social features with multiple users, verify privacy controls work correctly, and ensure performance data is accurate and secure.

tasks.title: Social Trading System
tasks.description: Enable users to follow successful traders and copy their strategies
tasks.details: Implement a social trading system where users can follow top performers, copy their strategies, and track performance. Include leaderboards, strategy sharing, and performance attribution.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with simulated trading data, verify strategy copying works correctly, and ensure performance tracking is accurate and transparent.

tasks.title: Market Sentiment Analysis
tasks.description: Implement community-driven market sentiment tracking and analysis
tasks.details: Create a system that aggregates community sentiment, social media mentions, and market discussions to provide real-time sentiment analysis for CS2 skin markets.
tasks.testStrategy: Test sentiment analysis accuracy with known market events, verify data sources are reliable, and ensure real-time updates work correctly.

tasks.title: Advanced Reporting Dashboard
tasks.description: Build professional-grade analytics and reporting tools for institutional clients
tasks.details: Create comprehensive reporting tools with advanced analytics, customizable dashboards, and professional-grade visualizations. Include export capabilities and compliance reporting.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various data sets, verify export functionality works correctly, and ensure reports meet professional standards and compliance requirements.

tasks.title: Compliance and Audit Tools
tasks.description: Implement regulatory reporting and audit trail functionality
tasks.details: Build compliance tools for regulatory reporting, audit trails, and data retention. Include automated compliance checks and reporting capabilities for different jurisdictions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test compliance features with various regulatory scenarios, verify audit trails are complete and accurate, and ensure reporting meets regulatory requirements.

tasks.title: Multi-Portfolio Management
tasks.description: Enable institutional account management with multiple portfolios
tasks.details: Create a system for managing multiple portfolios under one account, with role-based access, portfolio grouping, and institutional features like team management.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with multiple portfolios, verify access controls work correctly, and ensure team management features function as expected.

tasks.title: API Access and Developer Tools
tasks.description: Provide third-party integrations and developer access through comprehensive API
tasks.details: Build a comprehensive API for third-party integrations, including authentication, rate limiting, documentation, and developer tools. Include webhooks and real-time data access.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API endpoints with various clients, verify rate limiting works correctly, and ensure documentation is comprehensive and accurate.

tasks.title: Real News API Integration
tasks.description: Replace mock data with actual CS2 market news and sentiment data
tasks.details: Integrate real news APIs to provide actual market news, sentiment analysis, and economic calendar data instead of mock data. Include multiple news sources and real-time updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with real news data, verify sentiment analysis accuracy, and ensure real-time updates work correctly without overwhelming the system.

tasks.title: Advanced ML Models
tasks.description: Improve prediction accuracy with machine learning models
tasks.details: Develop and integrate advanced machine learning models for price predictions, market analysis, and portfolio optimization. Include model training, validation, and continuous improvement.
tasks.testStrategy: Test ML models with historical data, verify prediction accuracy, and ensure models can be retrained and improved over time.
